calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for PrepEdu
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the integration of Growthbook with Prep Edu's existing CMS, emphasizing the ease of deployment through a JavaScript SDK that allows for feature flagging and real-time experimentation without changing the backend. Concurrent experiments can be conducted through user segmentation and namespaces, ensuring controlled testing. Key details about pricing were also discussed, highlighting two self-hosted options—a free version and an enterprise tier costing $30,000 per year plus $750 per user. Additionally, Growthbook supports data integration with Prep Edu’s internal warehouse for analytics, ensuring compliance and data control. The conversation included plans for internal review and follow-up on pricing and features.
calls.keywords: Feature flagging, A/B testing, JavaScript SDK, Self-hosting, Experiment segmentation, Pricing model
